The '''Mila''' was one of the four [[akia]]s of [[Aramandi]] society. They were based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aram]], as well as the [[Mila system/Legends|Mila system]]. The akia colonized the Mila system after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] was established.<ref name="FBS" />

The Mila were liberal and businesslike, and were generally well liked by other Aramandi. It was the Mila who managed to come up with the new interpretation of the [[Eeronon]] to account for the existence of off-worlders. However, as a consequence, many of their number broke from the akia and formed the bulk of the [[Seelas]]. Members of the Mila akia dressed in bright, [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]]-like clothes.<ref name="FBS" />
